name: Necromancer minions ignore undetected stealthed players (#13147)
contract: Unit::_IsValidAttackTarget ignores stealth whenever the caller is in combat with a stealthed player.
Necromancer minions (npc_ascension_necromancer) checked owner->IsValidAttackTarget without checking stealth
detection and did not override CanAIAttack. Casting Crippling Shot 804725 from Elude 801345 keeps stealth
while putting both players into PvP combat, causing Undead: Assault 500982 minions to target and attack
the undetected Ranger; minions also kept attacking targets that re-stealthed out of detection range.
Minions must only hunt a stealthed player when CanSeeOrDetect succeeds through their owner's detection.
This scenario verifies: (1) Blackjack 520568 from 6 yd leaves both out of combat and minion idle,
(2) Crippling Shot 804725 from 15 yd puts the Necromancer in combat while Elude stays active and the
Undead: Assault Skeletal Warrior 50065 does not attack, (3) dropping Elude lets 50065 engage and
re-applying Elude causes 50065 to drop the undetected target, and (4) positive control with stealth
detection 18950 on the Necromancer lets 50065 detect and engage the stealthed Ranger.

SETUP: Necromancer is in PvP combat with Ranger
SETUP: Ranger remains in Elude stealth after Crippling Shot
Wait past two 1s minion UpdateAI cycles under Undead: Assault
DISCRIMINATING: aggressive minion does not attack undetected stealthed Ranger in PvP combat
Ranger still has Elude stealth active

Ranger re-enters Elude stealth mid-fight
DISCRIMINATING: minion drops Ranger once undetected in stealth
